sample_mapping_evidence: Ten explicit pediatric SLE PBMC donor labels SLE1-10, one RNA record each. This is whole PBMC validation, not the sorted CD4 GSE285773. Related5prime GSE298578 remains gated for cross-assay donor/specimen overlap review.

source_metadata.access: Public original CellRanger RNA triplets; sequencing access not required
source_processing: Illumina basecall files (*.bcl) were converted to fastqs using cellranger v3.0.2 which uses bcl2fastq v2.17.1.14. FASTQ files were then aligned to hg38 genome and transcriptome using the cellranger v3.0.2 pipeline, which generates a gene - cell expression matrix.

Supplementary files format and content: Transcriptomic counts matrices in Matrix Market CSR format. Rows correspond to features in the order provided in features.tsv/features.tsv and columns correspond to cell-barcodes in the order provided in barcodes.tsv.

title: PBMC from pediatric SLE donor, SLE1
extract_protocol_ch1: 10% DMSO + 90% FBS. PBMCs were thawed quickly at 37oC and into DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS. Cells exhibiting a viability rate less than 70% were excluded. Cells were quickly spun down at 400 g, for 10 min. Cells were washed once with 1 x PBS supplemented with 0.04% BSA and finally re-suspended in 1 x PBS with 0.04% BSA. Viability was determined using trypan blue staining and measured on a Countess FLII.

12,000 single cells were loaded into one lane of a 10X Genomics Chromium [Controller, X], targeting 6,000 barcoded single cells. Single cell capture, barcoding and library preparation were performed using the 10X Chromium platform, version [3, 3.1] chemistry. cDNA and libraries were checked for quality on Agilent 4200 Tapestation, quantified by KAPA qPCR, and sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000  targeting 100,000 raw read pairs per cell.
data_processing: Illumina basecall files (*.bcl) were converted to fastqs using cellranger v3.0.2 which uses bcl2fastq v2.17.1.14. FASTQ files were then aligned to hg38 genome and transcriptome using the cellranger v3.0.2 pipeline, which generates a gene - cell expression matrix.
Assembly: GRCh38

Supplementary files format and content: Transcriptomic counts matrices in Matrix Market CSR format. Rows correspond to features in the order provided in features.tsv/features.tsv and columns correspond to cell-barcodes in the order provided in barcodes.tsv.
